purpose: Teach: ポートフォリオ/プリンター/返金/レジュメ/数式/パートナーシップ/概算/アフター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 投資のポートフォリオ、見直す時期だ。
lines.en: Time to review our investment portfolio.
lines.style: Steady opening. Brief pause after the statement to let it land. Measured authority without harshness. Clear-eyed, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プリンター更新も、予算に含めます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll include printer replacement in the budget.
lines.style: Efficient, responsive. Quick acknowledgment with no wasted breath. Competent, keeping pace. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Crisp directive. Sharp attack on the key word. No question-mark inflection — this is instruction, not suggestion. Eyes on the standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 新入社員のレジュメ、集約しました。
lines.style: Straightforward report. Quiet satisfaction in completion. No flourish — just stating the work is done. Ready for the next item.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 分析の数式、共有しろ。パートナーシップ拡大、進めろ。
lines.en: Share the analysis formulas. Push the partnership expansion forward.
lines.style: Two clear directives, slight beat between them. Firm but not impatient. Each command gets its own weight. Expects execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 概算予算、来週役員会で報告。
lines.en: I'll report the preliminary budget at next week's board meeting.
lines.style: Confirmation of commitment. Steady, no apology in the tone. Professional assurance. Eyes forward to the timeline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: アフターサービス、顧客満足の核心だ。
lines.en: Aftercare is the heart of customer satisfaction.
lines.style: Weighs the statement as a principle. Slight deepening of tone — this is not just procedure, it's philosophy. Deliberate close. Finality.
